name: eis-cues
description: Drone Safety Platform — cue rails behind one CueAdapter. Node + browser core (no Electron, no DOM): scripted fixture replay, per-rail health, TTL expiry, rate limiting and whitelists for the sentinel2 / sar / sdr / rf_drone / cctv / fence_sensor / drone_survey rails. Emits only the existing `anomaly` and `healthEvent` wire messages.
